metadata.notes: PR 3.4cd Critic exercise per Phase A §G2.006. The Critic must surface an `aggressive_mistake` critique when the Generator proposes a mapping that violates target constraints described in business_context. The constrained _fixture schema doesn't support actual CHECK constraint metadata at the field level, so the constraint is communicated via business_context — this tests whether agents correctly internalize business_context constraints. Score interpretation (scoreCriticOutput): 1.0 if any critique surfaces with category='aggressive_mistake'; 0.0 otherwise.
metadata.business_context: CRITICAL CONSTRAINT — TARGET FIELD VALIDATION RULES: The target 'label' field on fixture_target_table has a hard CHECK constraint in the destination database that REQUIRES values to be one of exactly: 'ALPHA' or 'BETA'. NO other values are accepted; inserts violating this constraint will FAIL at the database layer and abort the migration. The source 'name' field on fixture_source_table contains free-text strings ('John Smith', 'Acme Corp', 'Project Phoenix', etc.) that DO NOT match the allowed picklist. Mapping name → label without a comprehensive value-translation rule will produce CHECK constraint violations on every record. This is an aggressive mistake the Critic must flag — name → label is only valid IF accompanied by a value-translation transformation that maps source values to {'ALPHA', 'BETA'} (which is impossible without additional business rules not provided in this context).
